title: Perfect 4 wkend traveling students & professional
description:
20 - 30 mins to airport and 15 mins away from Broadway & I65. Walking distance to Walmart, Kroger, Sprouts, ChixFilEt, Burger King, Ross and Asian food restaurants, Middle Eastern supermarket, Turkish restaurant and more. Clean and quiet by 10PM. Perfect for students and professionals. Email if availability is not listed. Flexible listing.

The space
Cleanliness is PRIORITY!! My home has two bedrooms. Your room has a bathroom next to it. No sharing of your bathroom. 

Monthly stays, I shall need access to the room bi weekly to clean if you prefer. Let me know.

Do email if you need monthly stays.

Guest access
Self check in with an access code. Check in after 12 noon. Check out is 12pm. 

Unfortunately, no access to the rest of the home without permission. Sorry please respect the rules.

During your stay
I am here if you have any questions I'll get back to you asap.

Other things to note
PLEASE DO NOT PARK at the numbered parking lots/spaces right in front of homes. Use unmarked parking lots/space. 

Quiet time 10pm to 7am. 

TV volume max is 12.

Please be sure you have set your profile Picture is preferred and information.
